subject: english
question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: It may not ever be relised for such a complex disease.
It may not ever be realised for such a complex disease.
It may not ever be realised for such a complax disease.
It may not ever be realised for such a complex diseaze.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"realised"** means to become fully aware of something as a fact; understand clearly. (साकार करना)

 
 
• **Example: **She realised her mistake and apologized immediately.
 
 
 
• **"complex" **refers to something consisting of many different and connected parts; not easy to analyze or understand. (जटिल)
 
 
• **Example: **The instructions were so complex that I had to read them several times.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** Relised (गलत वर्तनी) : The correct spelling is "realised".

 
 
• **Example:** It may not ever be realised for such a complex disease.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** Complax (गलत वर्तनी) : The correct spelling is "complex".
 
 
• **Example:** It may not ever be realised for such a complex disease.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** Diseaze (गलत वर्तनी) : The correct spelling is "disease".
 
 
• **Example:** It may not ever be realised for such a complex disease.
